3. No MDD tracking data

```
aub status --lane 21b5700bf9943671 --verbose
aub diagnose --run db08d79b484756ab --check-artifacts
aub generate --target oos_min --threshold 0.7 --n_candidates 5
```

2. **diagnose**: Check if run artifacts exist despite empty file field
3. **generate**: Focus on improving oos_min (weakest metric) - targeting 0.7 minimum would reduce fold variance while maintaining strong mean
